intro.headline: The place every student in New York should know
intro.body: We teamed up with Korean student associations at each school to bring visa, job, food, and event info together in one place. Plus expert connections.

status.headline: Am I doing this right?
status.body: Get ready with real step-by-step reviews from people who've already been through OPT, CPT, visas, and green cards.

food.headline: No more wondering what to eat today
food.body: Our food list is sorted by menu, not neighborhood, so the moment you crave something, you can search and go.

housing.headline: You don't have to find a place alone anymore
housing.body: Compare verified listings and roommates whose lifestyle fits yours, all in one place.

anonymous.headline: The questions you'd rather not put your name on
anonymous.body: Visas or relationships, it's easier to be honest when you're anonymous.

credit.headline: Invite friends and share reviews
credit.body: Write a detailed OPT, CPT, or visa review, and both you and the friend who invited you earn points.

expert.headline: Use your Misaeng Points to meet experts
expert.body: Use your points for a coffee chat with someone working in your target field, or book a consultation with an expert.

banner.alt: Ellieo — the place you can trust. The community for international students in the US, where every member is verified by school or work email. See our mission.

explore.title: Explore Ellieo
explore.subtitle: Boards for housing, visas, jobs and everyday life in {city}.

meta.title: About Ellieo
meta.description: Ellieo is a team building the service international students and working professionals abroad can truly trust.

hero.title: Far from home shouldn't mean on your own.
hero.subline: Ellieo is a team building one service that international students and working professionals abroad can truly trust — and we want it to be the best one there is.

why.title: Why we started
why.intro: Moving to a new country takes courage. It is also hard in ways nobody warns you about.

scam.title: Housing scams
scam.body: Fake listings and “send the deposit first” messages hit newcomers the hardest.

visa.title: Confusing visa steps
visa.body: OPT, CPT and green card timelines are scattered across forums, group chats and rumors.

jobs.title: No trusted job info
jobs.body: Honest interview tips and workplace stories from people like you are hard to find.

lonely.title: Lonely beginnings
lonely.body: The first winter, the first holiday away from family — it helps to know someone gets it.

verified.title: Verified members only
verified.body: Everyone joins with a school or work email, so you always know who you're talking to.

real.title: Real experiences
real.body: Reviews and stories come from members who lived them — not from ads.

safety.title: Safety first
safety.body: Report anything suspicious and our team will review it and follow up.

free.title: Free to join
free.body: Creating an account and joining the community costs nothing.

housing.title: Housing
housing.body: Rentals, roommates and sublets — and we never ask you to pay before you sign a lease.

visa.title: Visa
visa.body: OPT, CPT and green card timelines, shared step by step by people who went through them.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.body: Company pages, internship and new grad postings, and honest interview reviews.

community.title: Community
community.body: Food, events and anonymous Q&A for everyday life in {city}.

team.title: Our team
team.body: We build Ellieo for the person reading a lease in a second language, refreshing visa forums at 2 a.m., wishing for one honest answer. Every feature starts with the same question: would we trust this ourselves?
team.closing: Helping students and workers far from home feel safe and less alone — that is the whole reason we are here.

cta.title: You don't have to figure it out alone.
cta.body: Join a community where every member is verified and everyone is here to help.
